name: An insurrection of the Anarchists
descriptor: Your majesty! The townfolk have started to set riots! We must do something!

name: Tension between nations
descriptor: My king! Lately we have noticed tension between our nation and our main competitor in the borderlands. What should we do?

name: Empty Treasuries
descriptor: The royal coffers are nearly empty. We could tax the church's land to recover.

name: The Great Plague
descriptor: A mysterious plague is spreading through the slums. Should we quarantine the city?

name: Viking Longships
descriptor: Sails have been spotted on the horizon! They come for our gold!

name: Divine Vision
descriptor: A local peasant claims to have seen a saint. People want a cathedral built on that spot.

name: Trade Monopoly
descriptor: A powerful guild wants exclusive rights to sell silk. They offer a huge upfront payment.

name: Barbarian Mercenaries
descriptor: We can hire northern warriors to bolster our guard, but they are rowdy and violent.

name: Inquisition Request
descriptor: The High Priest wants to hunt down 'thinkers' who question the crown.

name: Bumper Harvest
descriptor: The fields are overflowing! Should we store the grain for war or sell it to neighbors?

name: Royal Marriage
descriptor: An alliance with the Eastern Empire requires you to marry their strange princess.

name: The Spy Master
descriptor: I have found a traitor in your inner circle. Shall I 'remove' him quietly?

name: Drought
descriptor: The river has dried up. The peasants are dying of thirst.

name: Corruption Scandal
descriptor: Your treasurer has been stealing. If we punish him, we lose his financial expertise.

name: Crusade Call
descriptor: The High Priest demands we join the holy war in the desert lands.

name: New Technology
descriptor: An alchemist claims to have invented 'Black Powder'. It's expensive but deadly.

name: Peasant Festival
descriptor: The people want a week-long feast to celebrate your reign. It will be costly.

name: The Weeping Statue
descriptor: A statue is crying blood. Thousands are flocking to see it, blocking the trade roads.

name: Bandit King
descriptor: A bandit has taken over the northern right. He demands a bribe to let merchants through.

name: Witch Hunt
descriptor: A girl is accused of cursing the cows. The mob wants her burned.
